card.name: The word cause in fetal harm warnings
card.fires_on: The verb "cause" right after "can" or "may" in an Embryo-Fetal Toxicity statement, just before "fetal harm".

modes.label: Embryo-fetal toxicity statement
modes.description: "cause" after a drug name and "can/may" in the embryo-fetal toxicity highlight or warning.
